title: CommunityRevision
description: OPTIONAL EXTENSION — not part of the three-object ontological core. A non-authoritative, revision-indexed analytical artifact derived from a compatible TIER-Graph projection (e.g. a graph community detected over a time-indexed edge set). A community revision MUST NOT be reused for a temporal projection unless compatibility is proven (see `derivedFromProjectionHash`).

profileId.description: The grounding profile of the projection this was derived from.

memberEntityIds.description: Entities that are members of the community.

derivedFromProjectionHash.description: Hash of the projection this artifact was derived from, used to prove compatibility before reuse.
